options.title: Entry metering + guide to the next station
options.rationale: Admit riders at Financial Centre only up to 85% load; guide the rest on foot to Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall. Simulated result: station-hours over the threshold go from 1.25 to 0, riders above the threshold from 1,274 to 0, and the peak station load from 139% to 85%. Added cost proxy: 3. Risk: Riders are turned away at the gates; needs staff and clear signs, and can load the next station.

Risk: Relies on visitors following the signs.

options.rationale: 6 shuttles from Financial Centre to Max, plus 30 robotaxis staged at Financial Centre. Simulated result: station-hours over the threshold go from 1.25 to 0.25, riders above the threshold from 1,274 to 82, and the peak station load from 139% to 94%. Added cost proxy: 54. Risk: Can shift crowding to the receiving station.
